```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(broom)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
```

# prepare the joined data
```{r}
# Sensor data
sensor_data <- read_csv(here("cleaned_data/master_data_pivot.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Make sure tide_data is loaded (from earlier)
# tide_data should already exist with date_time_hst and water_level_m

combined <- sensor_data %>%
  filter(site == "Kanewai", variable %in% c("pH", "oxygen", "temperature")) %>%
  left_join(
    tide_data %>% rename(tide_m = water_level_m),
    by = "date_time_hst"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tide_m), !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(
    hour   = hour(date_time_hst),
    is_day = hour >= 6 & hour < 18
  )

# Quick check
glimpse(combined)
table(combined$variable)
```

# compare linear vs cubic models +day/night
```{r}
# Helper to fit both models for one variable
fit_models <- function(df) {
  list(
    linear = lm(value ~ tide_m, data = df),
    cubic  = lm(value ~ poly(tide_m, 3, raw = TRUE), data = df),
    linear_day = lm(value ~ tide_m * is_day, data = df),
    cubic_day  = lm(value ~ poly(tide_m, 3, raw = TRUE) * is_day, data = df)
  )
}

results <- combined %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    models <- fit_models(.x)
    
    tibble(
      model = names(models),
      r_squared = map_dbl(models, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
      adj_r_squared = map_dbl(models, ~ summary(.x)$adj.r.squared),
      aic = map_dbl(models, AIC),
      # p-value of the overall model
      p_value = map_dbl(models, ~ {
        f <- summary(.x)$fstatistic
        if (is.null(f)) return(NA_real_)
        pf(f[1], f[2], f[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
      })
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Easy-to-read table
results %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(r_squared, adj_r_squared), ~ round(.x, 4)),
    aic = round(aic, 1),
    p_value = signif(p_value, 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable, model) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```

# day vs night correlations 
```{r}
day_night_cor <- combined %>%
  group_by(variable, is_day) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(value, tide_m, use = "complete.obs"),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = ifelse(is_day, "Day", "Night")) %>%
  select(variable, period, correlation, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = c(correlation, n))

print(day_night_cor)
```

# Visual check of linear vs cubic
```{r}
ggplot(combined, aes(x = tide_m, y = value)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x, 3), colour = "red", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Tide vs Sensor Values",
    subtitle = "Blue = linear, Red = cubic",
    x = "Tide height (m, MLLW)",
    y = "Sensor value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
